new_jobs.title: AVP, Data Science
new_jobs.description:
At MetLife, data isn’t just a tool – it is a catalyst for growth. As part of our Data & Analytics organization, you’ll unlock trusted insights that drive bold decisions, power personalized customer experiences, and deliver lasting business impact. We’re building the future of data – one that’s governed responsibly, engineered for scalability, and designed for growth. When you join us, you’re not just supporting the business – you’re empowering it. Let’s transform insight into impact and data into action, together.

The Opportunity

The AVP, Data Science is a senior leader within MetLife’s Enterprise Data Science & AI function, reporting to the Head of Data Science & AI, and is responsible for driving the delivery and enterprise adoption of data science, machine learning (ML), and generative AI solutions across the company’s global businesses and functions. The AVP oversees two areas, Applied Data Science and Enterprise AI Capabilities, and leads a team of 6–8 data scientists and ML engineers.

The AVP partners with business leaders and regional data officers to identify and deliver high-value use cases that support growth, profitability, and operational efficiency, and ensures solutions scale beyond pilots into production, where they are adopted and monitored. In parallel, the AVP builds reusable, production-grade AI capabilities, with the standards and practices that help regions move faster, with more consistency and quality, working closely with data engineering, technology, risk, and governance partners.

MetLife has a strong foundation in data science and a clear opportunity to turn it into enterprise-wide impact. The AVP is a change leader as much as a technical leader: a hands-on expert in statistical modeling, ML, and generative AI who earns credibility with experienced data scientists and regional leaders, leads through influence in a federated, global organization, and brings a product mindset focused on user experience and tangible business impact. The AVP balances innovation and creative problem solving with operational rigor and responsible AI in a regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the delivery of data science, ML, and AI solutions across key business areas, from problem definition through deployment and ongoing performance monitoring, with accountability for adoption and measurable business impact.
Partner with business leaders and regional data officers to identify, prioritize, and execute high-impact AI use cases tied to growth, profitability, and operational efficiency.
Apply a product approach to AI solutions: define users, adoption, and value measures up front, deliver a strong user experience, and ensure solutions are used, supported, and improved after launch.
Apply advanced statistical modeling, ML, and generative AI techniques to complex business problems, choosing the right method for each decision and translating insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
Drive experimentation and innovation through pilots and proofs of value, with a clear path to scale successful solutions across the enterprise or stop those that do not earn adoption.
Collaborate with data engineering, technology, and platform teams to build and scale enterprise-grade MLOps / AIOps capabilities, including model development, deployment, and monitoring.
Promote the reuse and standardization of models, data assets, and AI components across regions and teams to improve speed, consistency, and quality.
Contribute to the Data Science & AI Center of Excellence and communities of practice: share best practices, standards, and reusable tools, and encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of modern approaches across regions.
Partner with risk, legal, and governance teams so that AI solutions meet regulatory, ethical, and data protection requirements, and build to model governance standards for performance monitoring, fairness, transparency, and reliability.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of data scientists and ML engineers, focused on delivering impact in production, and foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture of continuous learning, innovation, and results.
Serve as a trusted partner to the Head of Data Science & AI: help shape priorities and the roadmap, represent the function with regional leaders and business partners, and communicate progress, value, and risks to senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Senior technical leader with 10+ years of significant experience delivering data science, ML, and AI solutions, and expert-level proficiency in statistical modeling, ML, and generative AI.
Familiarity with MLOps / AIOps and modern technology stacks, including the model lifecycle (deployment, monitoring, retraining), cloud ML platforms, and evaluation of generative AI.
Applied technology transformation delivery with measured business outcomes, including moving solutions from pilot to scaled production.
Strong product mindset, with an orientation to user experience and tangible business impact, balanced by innovation and creative problem solving.
Strong (4+ years) people leadership experience: coaching, developing, and leading a team effectively.
Skilled in stakeholder management, with the ability to communicate with and influence senior business and technology leaders across a complex, global environment.
Degree in a quantitative or technical field required; Master’s degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Model governance experience, and delivering AI/ML solutions in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services.
Experience operating at global Fortune 500 scale and complexity.

Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role r equiring a minimum of 3 days per week
in office.

The expected salary range for this position is $190,000 - $230,000. This role may also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation and stock-based long-term incentives. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.

Benefits We Offer

Our U.S. benefits address holistic well-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no-cost short- and long-term disability. We also provide company-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please click here.

About MetLife

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

MetLife is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are made without regards to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status (although applicants and employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States), uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law (“protected characteristics”).

If you need an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at accommodations@metlife.com. This information will be held in confidence and used only to determine an appropriate accommodation for the application process.

MetLife maintains a drug-free workplace.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liabilities.

new_jobs.title: Data Science Associate
new_jobs.description:
About Onyx.

Onyx is building the market for people who enjoy being right. Our consumer platform lets people take positions on what happens next across sports, prediction markets, crypto, financial markets, politics, culture, and real-world events.

More than one million users have already found Onyx. Now, we’re bringing that same energy into regulated financial markets through Onyx Predictions, a CFTC-registered introducing broker and NFA member.

In June 2026, we raised a $20 million Series A led by Payward, the parent company of Kraken, valuing Onyx at $220 million less than one year after emerging from beta. Our team comes from Jane Street, DraftKings, Robinhood, xAI, SIG, HRT, and Harvard.

We’re building Onyx in New York with a small team, serious momentum, and no interest in moving slowly. The product is live. The market is growing. The category is still ours to define.

The Role.

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help teams across Onyx make better decisions with data. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, and Trading to understand user behavior, measure product changes, identify opportunities, and influence what we build next.

You’ll combine strong analytical skills with business judgment. You’ll take projects from the initial question through analysis and recommendations, and build the metrics and tools that help teams answer important questions themselves.

What You’ll Own

Partner with teams to define success metrics, evaluate performance, and identify opportunities.
Design and analyze experiments, including tests of product changes, customer journeys, and growth initiatives.
Investigate user behavior across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.
Build analytical frameworks, models, and forecasts to inform product and business decisions.
Develop datasets, dashboards, and tools that make reliable data easier to access and use.
Own data projects end to end, from scoping the question to communicating findings and recommendations.
Help improve event tracking, data quality, and the reliability of core metrics.
Explain results clearly, including uncertainty and limitations, to both technical and nontechnical partners.
Work with Engineering to make data collection and analysis more dependable as the product grows.

You’ll Do Well Here If You

Have 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related role.
Are fluent in SQL and proficient in Python or R.
Have a strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, and/or forecasting.
Have worked with large datasets and distributed data systems.
Can turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analysis and practical recommendations.
Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners.
Have supported product, growth, finance, platform, or internal tooling teams.
Take ownership and can deliver useful work in a fast-moving environment.

Even Better If You Have

Experience at a consumer product, fintech, trading, crypto, sports, or prediction markets company.
Familiarity with event-based products, marketplaces, or financial transactions.
Built data tools, reusable datasets, or self-serve analytics workflows.
Experience improving experimentation practices or product instrumentation.

Location:

This role is based in our NoHo, Manhattan office, with core in-office days Tuesday through Thursday.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Onyx is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position.

Compensation And Benefits

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $150,000–$200,000, depending on experience, impact, and scope, plus target bonus and equity.

Benefits Include

Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Meaningful equity ownership.
Commuter benefits.

Why Onyx?

Onyx is for people with conviction.

We hire talented people, give them meaningful ownership, and expect them to use it. Our teams stay small, the work stays visible, and the distance between an idea and production stays short.

Onyx moves quickly because our markets move quickly. Titles matter less than judgment, initiative, and the quality of what you ship. Good ideas can come from anywhere, but the person willing to make the call is expected to follow it through.

We value people who are ambitious without ego, intellectually honest, comfortable with uncertainty, and energized by hard problems. We debate openly, decide quickly, and take responsibility for the result.

Come build what’s next with us.

new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for a Senior Research Associate to join our US SMID-Cap Software team in New York e.g. Palo Alto Networks, Atlassian, Datadog, GitLab, ServiceNow. If you have a passion for research and are interested in building a long-term career in the investing world, there’s no better place to start than Bernstein. We seek candidates who love to solve problems, analyze data, and are passionate about in-depth fundamental analysis. We offer a unique opportunity to become an industry expert as you work alongside a seasoned veteran who will mentor and develop you. These roles offer a path to more senior opportunities within Bernstein.

As a Senior Research Associate, you will:

Become an industry expert working one-on-one with a Senior Analyst who often has 10-15 years of prior industry experience in consulting and/or management roles
Become highly proficient at in-depth analysis of your companies, stocks, and industry themes
Author highly differentiated written research that is famous for its deep industry insights and quantitative frameworks, including our signature Blackbook product
Become adept at financial forecasting, including building detailed forward-looking models
Build strong relationships across the investing community including our sales and trading teams and institutional clients
Build a network within your industry including senior managements of your companies
Act as team COO and actively manage your franchise’s workflow

We have an outstanding Associate program and make a strong commitment to your development. Our culture is intellectually rigorous, but it is also very collegial and fun. We have robust learning and development programs as well as annual offsite events. We offer a flexible work schedule, but our in-office environment is very active. Our Associates are highly involved in (and often lead) our firm’s cultural initiatives, ranging from health & wellness, community service, mentoring, employee resource groups, social events, and Associate leadership.

The role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and includes a competitive benefits package including 401(k) plan with company match, Medical/Dental/Vision, and other benefits for fertility, wellness, student loans and commuters. Base salary range does not include overtime pay, bonus and/or other benefits, where applicable. Actual base salary offer will vary based on skills and experience.

Required

Profile required

For our Senior Research Associate roles, we look for candidates with thought leadership, intellectual breadth, quantitative rigor and a differentiated approach to solving problems. We carefully consider your academic background as well as any prior work experience for evidence of the following:

Basic Qualifications

Relentless intellectual curiosity and an aptitude for solving complex problems
Organic leadership and an entrepreneurial mindset
Demonstrated outstanding verbal and written communication skills
Strong quantitative skills and ability to work with data sets, including STEM undergraduate degrees
Best-in-class broad-based analytical skills
Willingness to own work and maintain accountability
Collaborative, team-player attitude
Bachelor’s degree plus MBA or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience accessing emerging technological advancements and their potential to disrupt traditional software markets

We provide an intellectually challenging but supportive environment and look for leaders who are also team players who can collaborate. Our Associate positions have historically been excellent platforms for internal advancement to Vice President and Senior Analyst roles. We additionally have many Associates go on to successful investing careers at our clients.

Business insight

Bernstein is widely recognized as a premier global equity research and brokerage firm, with a trading platform that spans the US, Europe, and Asia. Our research and trading capabilities are sought out by leading investment managers around the world, and we have a long history of our research receiving #1 rankings for overall quality and industry knowledge.

Research is our legacy and foundation. Our brand is defined by our Blackbooks, renowned for their in-depth quantitative forecasts and unmatched industry expertise. Our Research Analysts are thought leaders who typically have many years of direct experience in the industries they cover. Our reputation is for the very highest caliber of disciplined investment and industry analysis.

In 2019 Bernstein acquired Autonomous Research, a highly regarded global financial services independent research firm. This acquisition further strengthened us as the preeminent provider of the highest-quality research to our clients worldwide.

On April 1, 2024, AllianceBernstein and Societe Generale announced the official launch of Bernstein, a new joint venture expanding our global cash equities and equity research business. Clients now have unparalleled equity liquidity access and a full range of integrated services, leveraging Bernstein’s cash equities and research capabilities and Societe Generale’s equity derivatives, prime services and equity capital markets offering.

Gallo Privacy Policy

We are GALLO

We’re a family-owned company with a 90+ year legacy, that’s consistently recognized as a Glassdoor “Best Places to Work.” We have 130+ brands in our total alcohol beverage portfolio including wine, malt, spirits, and ready-to-drink beverages. We’re home to the #1 wine and spirits brands in the U.S. - Barefoot Wine & High Noon and are the official sponsors of the NFL, NHL, UFC, and PGA of America.

View our Corporate Values and Mission Statement here.

SHIFT NOTE: This position requires candidates to be open to working any and all shifts (Day, Swing, or Grave). Shift will be based on business need. Further information will be provided as candidates move through the process.

A Taste of What You’ll Do

Under general supervision, you’ll play an important role in supporting the quality and consistency of our winery products by performing microbiological analysis of alcoholic beverages, such as wine and spirit based products. Your work will directly support winemaking and quality teams by ensuring accurate testing, timely reporting, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

In this hands-on laboratory role, you’ll support microbiological analysis activities such as sample plating, plate reading, sample collection, and sanitation monitoring. You’ll help prepare media, sterilize bottles, prepare laboratory solutions, and assist with maintaining clean, organized analytical and micro-labs. You’ll also collect and deliver wine samples on a scheduled basis from the cellar, bottling room, and MSC to the WAM laboratory.

You’ll log sample results into the laboratory information management system so winemakers, team leaders, operations managers, and quality leadership have real-time visibility into product quality. You’ll generate status and sample reports, follow response plans when samples fall outside of tolerance, and contribute ideas to improve laboratory practices.

This role requires a strong commitment to safety, quality, and teamwork. If you’re eager to make a meaningful impact while growing your career, we encourage you to apply!

What You’ll Need

Bachelor's Degree OR High School diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus 1 year GALLO experience OR High School diploma or State-issued equivalency certificate plus 3 years laboratory support, winery or vineyard experience.
Experienced in reading and comprehending simple instructions, correspondence, and memos.
Experienced in writing simple correspondence and procedures.
Skilled in adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing using whole numbers.
Required to maintain 3 shift availability (day, swing, and graveyard); required to work overtime when necessary; required to work weekends when necessary.
Required to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
Required to stand for long periods of time.
Required to be at least 21 years of age.
Required to travel to company offices, sites, and/or meeting locations for onboarding, training, meetings, and events for development, department needs, and business delivery up to 5% of the time, with or without reasonable accommodation. This may be in addition to travel requirements, if applicable, as listed in this job description.
Required to be 18 years or older. This may be in addition to other age requirements, if applicable, as listed in this job description.

How You’ll Stand Out

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Microbiology, Food Science, or Biochemistry plus lab support or quality assurance experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience maintaining and troubleshooting lab equipment.
Experience operating machines and equipment such as a manual-shift motor scooter, computer and various meters and testing devices.
Skilled in the use of MS Word and Excel
Strong verbal, written, analytical and interpersonal skills.
Experience reading and interpreting documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals.

new_jobs.title: Research Associate II/Sr. Research Associate – Surface Chemistry
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Sarmal, Inc. is a San Diego–based biotechnology company developing next-generation genomics and molecular detection platforms. Our work integrates molecular biology, chemistry, and advanced systems engineering to enable faster, more precise, and more accessible genomic insights.

We are a highly collaborative, R&D-driven team operating in a fast-paced, early-stage environment. Our scientists and engineers work across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges and translate innovation into scalable, real-world applications.

At Sarmal, we value scientific rigor, curiosity, and a builder mindset. We are looking for individuals who are energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and excited to help bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

About The Job

Sarmal is seeking a RA2/Senior RA to support production-oriented execution of surface functionalization processes for a biosensor device platform. This is primarily a hands-on execution role for someone with real industry lab experience — running batch processes against documented procedures largely independently, generating consistent and well-documented results, and supporting the team's pilot-scale/production ramp. Strong execution and reliability in the first phase may open the door to broader involvement in experimental/research support work as the program progresses. Not looking for entry-level/new-grad candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Execute surface functionalization batch runs (SAM, silane, hydrogel, brush polymer chemistries) per written SOPs/batch records, working independently after initial onboarding.
Independently operate the team's core surface characterization methods — fluorescence-based uniformity assays, contact angle, and EIS/CV — for routine batch and process characterization.
Summarize characterization results (thickness, density, uniformity, charge) and flag trends relevant to assay performance (signal, specificity, non-specific binding) for scientist review.
Support development of nucleotide-based assay consumables and other biofunctionalized surface work (e.g., oligonucleotide/probe immobilization, hybridization assays, bioconjugation in microarray/biointerface contexts).
Assist with surface deposition/patterning process runs (spin-coating, dip-coating, spray-coating, plasma treatment/activation; exposure to PE-CVD/CVD or photolithographic patterning a plus).
Execute DOE test plans designed by scientists, applying basic statistical analysis (ANOVA, regression, or similar) to interpret and summarize results; input into test design as experience builds.
Log data accurately and promptly in lab notebooks/ELN; flag and help investigate deviations from expected process parameters.
Maintain organized inventory of chemistry consumables and reagents used in daily runs.
Maintain cleanroom/lab space per site protocols.
Work collaboratively with in-house scientists; expected to troubleshoot routine issues independently and escalate non-routine ones.

Qualifications

Hands-on experience working with interfacial materials (2D surface, microarray, flow cell, nanoparticle, membranes, etc.) and executing relevant analytical methods e.g. fluorescence-based uniformity assays, goniometry, etc.
Familiarity with nucleotide-based assay chemistries or other biofunctionalized surfaces (e.g., oligonucleotide/probe immobilization, hybridization assays, bioconjugation in microarray/biointerface contexts).
Demonstrated track record of independent, precise batch/production execution within a structured process or manufacturing pipeline.
Working knowledge of DOE fundamentals and basic statistical analysis, sufficient to execute and interpret a senior-designed test plan.
Comfort with structured documentation (batch records, ELN, GDP-style recordkeeping).

Education

B.S. or M.S. in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, bioengineering, or related field, or equivalent industry experience + 2–4 years of hands-on industry lab experience with surface chemistry, thin-film deposition, or related wet-chemistry processes

Benefits & Perks

Sarmal offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including:

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Company-paid life insurance
401(k) retirement plan
Generous paid time off
Access to additional voluntary benefits, employee perks, and discount programs
We are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and providing a strong foundation for both professional and personal success.

$72,000 - $85,000 a year

California Pay Transparency Statement.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $72,000 – $85,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skill set, and internal equity considerations.

Sarmal is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Sarmal is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and consider all qualified candidates in accordance with applicable laws.

Why Join Sarmal

Work on cutting-edge genomics and molecular detection technologies
Collaborate with a deeply technical, cross-functional team
Contribute to foundational platform development at an early stage
Have visibility into and impact on core technical and strategic decisions
Help shape the infrastructure, culture, and future direction of the company

new_jobs.description:
1168044_RR00125930 Job ID: 1168044_RR00125930

NYU Langone Health is a fully integrated health system that consistently achieves the best patient outcomes through a rigorous focus on quality that has resulted in some of the lowest mortality rates in the nation. Vizient Inc. has ranked NYU Langone the No. 1 comprehensive academic medical center in the country for three years in a row, and U.S. News & World Report recently placed nine of its clinical specialties among the top five in the nation. NYU Langone offers a comprehensive range of medical services with one high standard of care across 6 inpatient locations, its Perlmutter Cancer Center, and over 320 outpatient locations in the New York area and Florida. With $14.2 billion in revenue this year, the system also includes two tuition-free medical schools, in Manhattan and on Long Island, and a vast research enterprise with over $1 billion in active awards from the National Institutes of Health.

For more information, go to NYU Langone Health , and interact with us on LinkedIn , Glassdoor , Indeed , Facebook , X , YouTube and Instagram .

Position Summary

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Laboratory Assistant.

In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible for screening and accessioning specimens into LIS. Tasked with reconciling specimen information as samples are submitted for examination/testing. Responsible for LIS work queues, quality control/audits, and coordination of specimen transport from provider to laboratories and between laboratories. Processes all samples according to NYU policy/procedure.

Job Responsibilities

Accepts specimens from delivery person, window or pneumatic tube system. When required, ensures log/manifest matches actual specimens received, signs off on all received specimens. Verifies that each specimen is accompanied by LIS barcode label or demographic label and acceptable requisition. Confirms each specimen is appropriate for the test requested. Verifies that each specimen label is complete with name, medical record number and all required information as per standard operating procedure. Verifies that the identifying information on the label matches that on the requisition and that the information on the requisition is complete and accurate.
Notifies appropriate personnel in cases of unacceptable samples (ie mislabeled, unlabeled, discrepant information) and documents according to department specific procedures. Resolves problems with specimen receipt and appropriateness of test requisitions/samples when possible and according to SOP.
Timely processing of all samples. Accessions(receives) sorts, racks and distributes specimens according to established procedures, making sure that special comments and instructions are observed. Processes stats and specimens with time-sensitive protocols in a timely manner. Notifies appropriate house staff and pathologists of frozen section cases. Labels specimens with LIS labels correctly as required. Delivers specimens and labels to the appropriate laboratory or instrument.
Registers patients and places orders based on manual requisitions or as corrective action for improperly placed orders entered by providers
Answer telephones. Provides customer service to Laboratory and Medical staff. Answers telephones promptly, converses courteously and directs calls in a professional manner. Responds promptly to laboratory and medical staff who come to the laboratory. Provides accurate information to inquiries from the medical staff. Faxes results to physicians offices or other institutions as per policy. Responds promptly to requests from providers (for example STATs and Add On requests). In the absence of customer service personnel, communicates critical values to provider as per policy.
Processes Samples for Automated Instrumentation. Enters required pre-analytic information into medical record at accessioning (source, volume, tube# etc.) Centrifugation of samples as required and placement on automated test platforms as per protocol. May include removing caps from tubes of blood and body fluid.
Arrange courier pickups as needed (portal and/or phone).
General department maintenance. Cleans all laboratory work surfaces and assigned areas in accordance with laboratory protocols and documents as required. Maintains an organized workspace and restocks supplies as needed. Notifies supervisor of any shortage of supplies
Follows all safety requirements for PPE and the utilization of engineering controls to maintain a safe work environment.
Participates in the training of new lab accessioning staff.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Process and prepare patient specimens for referral to outside laboratories, ensuring accurate labeling, documentation, packaging, and shipping in compliance with laboratory procedures and regulatory requirements.
Verify test orders, maintain specimen integrity and turnaround expectations, track send-out status and results, and communicate effectively with laboratory staff, couriers, and reference labs to resolve discrepancies.

Minimum Qualifications

High School Graduate.
0 to 6 months experience in laboratory.
Excellent communication skills.
Excellent computer/data entry skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior accessioning experience. Knowledge of medical terminology.

Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.

NYU Langone Health provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents.

At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

NYU Langone Health is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

About Us

Seawolf Therapeutics is a venture-backed company based in San Diego, CA. We are an innovative and collaborative team developing DNA-based medicines that will be first-in-class and best-in-class long-acting therapeutics for patients living with unmet medical needs. Come join our team and be an agent of change.

Overview of the Role

We are seeking a Research Associate/Sr. Research Associate to join our Analytical Development team and facilitate our formulation development efforts. This is a hands-on, on-site laboratory role, with approximately 80% lab-based work and 20% dedicated to data entry and experiment planning. This individual will be actively engaged in developing methodologies to analyze advanced nucleic acid-based therapeutics. A key point of focus will be execution of high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC)-and capillary electrophoresis (CE)-based analyses for characterizing lipid nanoparticle (LNP) drug product formulations. This role requires both the ability to execute routine testing following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and the initiative to assist in developing new analytical methods in collaboration with other analytical team members. This role additionally requires a passion for scientific discovery, interdisciplinary collaboration, good organization and record keeping, and the ability to present and discuss work across functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in the development of new analytical methods for the characterization of lipids, nucleic acids, and nanoparticle formulations.
Perform routine analytical testing of in-process and drug product LNP formulations to assess key attributes such as concentration, identity, purity, and integrity.
Maintain meticulous documentation of all experimental data, procedures, and protocols.
Maintain organized storage and inventory of supplies and materials.
Collaborate with a team of scientists to creatively solve problems and drive innovation.
Maintain high standards for scientific integrity and accountability.
Communicate across departments and support project teams.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

BS/MS in chemistry, chemical engineering, bioengineering or related field with at least 2 years of relevant industry experience.

Technical Skills

Prior hands-on experience with the following:
HPLC instrument setup and data analysis, ideally across multiple separation modalities with different stationary and mobile phases.
CE instrument setup and data analysis, ideally across multiple instrumentation platforms.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for experimental and equipment-related issues.
Fundamental knowledge of assay development, performance, and quality standards, including how to assess accuracy and precision during method qualification or validation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Excel, Word) for data documentation and analysis.
Experience with automation tools is a plus.
Able to conduct self-directed research and thrive in a fast-paced entrepreneurial setting with a diverse team of coworkers.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and meticulous data documentation.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy.
Effective verbal and written communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
Exceptional problem-solving skills, outstanding interpersonal skills, creativity, enthusiasm, reliability.
Flexibility to adapt to evolving project priorities in a dynamic environment.
A team-oriented, startup mentality, willing to take on multiple responsibilities.
Scientifically curious, paired with a strong work ethic and grit.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of demonstrating how AI tools can accelerate scientific workflows and enable discovery.

About The Role

We are hiring Research Associates: early-career bench scientists who will join a small team to help establish our biology research program. This is an entry-level role, great for individuals who have done some research during an undergrad or masters program and may be considering pursuing a PhD in Life Sciences in the future.

You'll work directly alongside senior scientists, executing and troubleshooting experiments at the bench while learning advanced techniques in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. We value curiosity, careful hands, and the willingness to take ownership of a result. Our scientists are eager to teach; we're hiring for motivation and trajectory as much as for existing skill.

This is a fully hands-on bench role — while familiarity with computational biology and bioinformatics is welcome, the role does not involve AI/ML model development.

Key responsibilities

Execute molecular biology and biochemistry experiments at the bench under the direction of senior scientists
Maintain meticulous, reproducible records and contribute to shared protocols
Troubleshoot experiments, propose adjustments, and present results clearly in group meetings
Maintain mammalian and bacterial cell lines, materials stocks, and reagent inventories
Learn and adopt new techniques rapidly as projects evolve, with training provided

Minimum Qualifications

Have hands-on research experience in molecular biology, biochemistry, or a closely related field
Are proficient with foundational molecular biology techniques: PCR, gel electrophoresis, molecular cloning, and plasmid preparation
Have experience with aseptic technique and bacterial or mammalian cell culture, and with nucleic acid extraction, purification, and quantification
Follow, document, and adapt experimental protocols with care and precision
Are highly motivated, eager to learn, and energized by hands-on bench work
Are practical and resourceful — you'd rather find a way through than a reason it can't be done
Listen carefully, take feedback well, ask good questions, and are comfortable when priorities shift quickly
Are excited to use AI models as a tool at the bench to plan experiments, interpret data, and decide what to try next

Preferred Qualifications

A BS or MS in molecular biology, biochemistry, chemical biology, microbiology, bioengineering, or a related discipline
Protein expression and purification experience (e.g., affinity, SEC, IEX)
Mammalian cell culture experience, including transfection and stable line maintenance
Enzyme kinetics or quantitative biochemical assay development (fluorescence, absorbance, FRET)
Next-generation sequencing library preparation experience
Familiarity with common bioinformatics workflows and molecular biology software (e.g., sequence analysis, alignment, primer and construct design)
Experience using AI tools such as Claude in a research setting — for literature review, protocol drafting, data interpretation, or experimental troubleshooting

This is a rare opportunity to help define how a frontier AI company does biology. You'll learn quickly, work closely with people who want to teach, and see your results feed directly into how the most capable AI models are evaluated and improved.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$95,000—$120,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Job Description

The Institute for Immunity, Transplantation and Infection at Stanford University is seeking a highly motivated Life Science Research Professional 2 to join the Mark Davis laboratory using human immune organoids to study the fundamentals of human immunology in order to advance our understanding of responses to vaccination or infection. You will be working with Dr. Mark Davis, a world leader in immunology. As an LSRP2, your duties will include processing human samples, cell culture, performing classical immunology experiments (flow cytometry, ELISA), and participating in cutting edge technologies (including CyTOF, single cell RNA-seq, and single cell ATAC-seq, and techniques in development in the lab). You will function largely independently on a daily basis after training, with close guidance and supervision from a research scientist. Your work will be central to several major research projects, and co-authorship on high-impact publications is expected.

The research will require you to be adaptable and able to work in a fast-paced environment. Learning new techniques in the lab or from other labs to increase expertise will be encouraged. Candidates should have excellent communication skills, be highly organized, and comfortable with new technology. BS degree, or equivalent, with previous experience in laboratories is required. Quality Control Technician

About The Job

Job Location: Kansas City

Title:
Quality Control Technician

Company:
DeLaval

Location:
Onsite in Kansas City, MO

Hours:
7 AM- 4 PM Monday- Friday

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Control Technician to help ensure products and materials meet a defined set of quality standards. Key responsibilities include examining shipments of inventory and raw materials, measuring product specifications throughout production runs, and training team members to maintain and improve product quality.

In Support Of Our Amazing Team, We Offer

Competitive compensation
Year-end bonus
Paid vacation plus additional time off at the end of the year
401K with company match
Medical, Dental, Vision
Work life balance
And MORE!

About DeLaval

DeLaval is a leading global supplier of solutions that improve the performance of farms for professional food producers. We support our customers in reducing their environmental footprint while improving food production, profitability and the well -being of the people and animals involved. We offer products, systems and services for all steps of milk production.

Our solutions are used by millions of dairy farmers around the globe every day.

At DeLaval, we prioritize our people and their safety. We pride ourselves on our culture of thinking and acting as One DeLaval. We also empower our people to Make Things Happen and encourage Setting Direction .

Learn more DeLaval, please visit us at www.delaval.com/en-us/

Key Responsibilities

Interpret drawings and specifications, including tolerances, critical-to-quality dimensions (CTQs), surface finish requirements, material grades, and fit/function requirements.
Measure and verify product dimensions using tools such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, and plug gauges to confirm dimensional accuracy.
Follow established sampling rules, batch sampling plans, and acceptance limits to ensure pass/fail decisions are consistent and defensible, especially when 100% inspection is not practical.
Verify visual and finish standards, including surface defects, labeling, assembly correctness, weld/solder appearance (where applicable), and packaging integrity based on defined defect criteria.
Identify recurring quality issues and document trends. Support root-cause investigations using structured problem-solving tools such as Ishikawa (Fishbone) diagrams to analyze potential causes related to people, processes, materials, and equipment.
Initiate containment activities when necessary by holding suspect lots, isolating nonconforming material, and preventing the mixing of acceptable and questionable inventory.
Accurately record measurements, test results, and pass/fail decisions, including appropriate timestamps and batch or serial number identifiers.
Maintain traceability by linking inspection results to specific lot numbers, supplier batches, machine lines, and operator shifts when applicable.
Properly document deviations, including what failed, how it failed, and actions taken to address the issue.
Manage controlled documents and ensure the use of current checklists, SOPs, test methods, and inspection plans.
Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits by maintaining complete and accurate quality records.
Perform in-process inspections by verifying dimensions and process parameters at defined intervals throughout production.
Verify calibration status and condition of measuring tools, gauges, and inspection equipment, including calibration labels and due dates.
Validate mistake-proofing (Poka-Yoke) controls by ensuring sensors, fixtures, interlocks, and alarms function as intended and are not bypassed or ignored.

Requirements

High School Diploma or General Educational Development (GED) is required.
Demonstrates the ability to apply mathematical and scientific reasoning, interpret written, verbal, and visual instructions, and build knowledge of ISO 9000 expectations and concepts.
Effectively manages personal work priorities, communicates clearly with internal customers, proactively addresses issues, and escalates barriers to management when appropriate.
Well organized with the ability to multitask.
On an average 8-hour day, ability to walk, sit, stand, use hands to handle or feel, reach at or above shoulder height and below waist height, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk and hear, smell, and lift up to 50 pounds.
Specific vision requirements include reading written documents, visual inspection of materials, and frequent use of a computer monitor.
Operate pallet jack with a maximum weight load of 1,000 pounds during a scheduled shift as needed.

If you’re passionate about delivering exceptional, safety, quality processes and products, thrive in a collaborative team environment, embrace continuous improvement, and want to have a meaningful voice in shaping our processes—we want to hear from you!

We are an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Large Molecules, Process Development)
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in antibody process development and manufacturing to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert in making antibodies, with hands-on experience expressing, purifying, characterizing, and formulating them, from small screening batches to material for IND-enabling studies. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll build and run the workflows that turn AI-designed sequences into well-characterized protein, and pressure-test AI predictions of expression, stability, and manufacturability against real data.

This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Key responsibilities

Develop and run expression and purification processes for antibodies and other recombinant proteins end to end, including transient and stable expression in mammalian cells (HEK293, CHO), affinity capture (Protein A, IMAC), polishing chromatography, buffer exchange, and formulation
Characterize what we make with the right analytical panel, for example SEC, CE-SDS, icIEF, LC-MS (intact mass, peptide mapping, glycans), DLS, thermal stability, endotoxin, and binding kinetics (SPR, BLI)
Build the laboratory for this work, including selecting, installing, and qualifying equipment and setting up workflows that scale from plate-based production of hundreds of designs to gram quantities of a lead
Evaluate AI-designed antibodies for manufacturability (titer, aggregation, stability under stress, viscosity, chemical liabilities), drive them to experimental readout, and feed results back to research teams
Plan the chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) path toward IND-enabling studies, from cell line development and scale-up to analytical methods and stability, and coordinate technology transfer and manufacturing with external contract manufacturers
Ensure experimental data across programs is high quality and well documented, including batch records, methods, raw data, and failure modes
Communicate findings clearly to biology, AI research, and life sciences audiences

Minimum Qualifications

PhD in biochemical engineering, chemical engineering, biochemistry, or a related field
Demonstrated experience in process development and manufacturing of antibodies or other recombinant proteins, including material supplied for IND-enabling or clinical studies, with recent, sustained hands-on laboratory work
Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of biologics process development experience beyond the PhD
Depth in both upstream (cell line development, bioreactors) and downstream (chromatography, filtration) development, with working knowledge of analytical and formulation development
Experience setting up a protein production or process development laboratory, including laboratory automation and high-throughput, plate-based expression and purification
Experience directing technology transfer and GMP manufacturing at contract development and manufacturing organizations, with contributions to the CMC sections of an IND
Statistics or coding skills, for example design of experiments or Python for data analysis and automation
Experience using AI or ML tools in the life sciences
Publications and/or patents demonstrating scientific impact

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$300,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Bioinformatics Scientist, MRD
new_jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Position Overview

The Senior Bioinformatics Scientist will serve as a technical lead and subject matter expert within the Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) program, working collaboratively with senior scientists and leaders on complex Research and Development projects. In this role, you will participate in or lead the planning of projects and analyses, and often act as the bioinformatics lead responsible for successful project execution. You will independently determine methods and procedures for new assignments, make detailed observations, analyze data, interpret results, and provide insights that shape the next steps and direction of the project. Your work will center on developing novel methods to identify and integrate genomic and epigenetic biomarkers that improve the sensitivity and specificity of MRD assays, contributing end-to-end across the data science workflow : collecting public datasets, curating internal data, forming hypotheses, building and validating models, and exploring machine learning and AI-based approaches. You will also research new technologies, contribute ideas and concepts to improve or develop processes, and help establish methods and workflows that advance product development toward diagnostic assay products.

Essential Duties

Include, but are not limited to, the following :

Technical leadership : Serve as bioinformatics lead and subject matter expert on one or more complex R&D projects, including those supporting diagnostic assay product development, and lead or participate in project and analysis planning.
Analysis and interpretation : Independently analyze experimental data across several product or technology areas, interpret results, identify trends, problems, and discrepancies, and recommend next steps and project direction.
Complex problem solving : Tackle problems of extremely complex scope where intangible variables must be evaluated, applying independent judgment to define methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria.
Method and study design : Independently develop methods, procedures, and development plans for new studies, and give technical input on project planning and experimental design.
Data and computational management : Manage bench-generated data and bioinformatics outputs in HPC or cloud computing environments, selecting and applying the right methods and technologies.
Data quality : Evaluate the impact of nonconforming data on products or processes and address trends in study data.
Innovation and IP : Track industry and technology developments, propose new techniques, lead process improvements, and contribute to the intellectual property portfolio.
Communication and presentation : Present and defend scientific findings at data, group, project, and departmental meetings, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, including functional managers and the clinical lab.
Documentation and compliance : Prepare and approve technical procedures, protocols, and reports, support abstracts, conferences, and publications, and follow legal, ISO, QSR, and Quality Management System requirements.
Mentorship and collaboration : Train and mentor research associates and junior scientists, foster a trusting, collaborative team environment, and manage multiple projects with shifting priorities.
Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.
Ability to travel 5% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.

Minimum Qualifications

Ph.D. in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field; or Master’s degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field plus 4 years of experience in lieu of a Ph.D.; or Bachelor’s degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, mathematics, or related field plus 6 years of experience in lieu of Ph.D.
5+ years of industry or academia experience in bioinformatics.
3+ years of experience in medical device/IVD, biotech, life science or pharmaceutical industry.
Extensive experience in Linux-based HPC or cloud computing environments and associated tools.
Ability to write custom code in at least three programming or scripting languages.
Technical expert in the area of molecular biology and/or biochemistry and/or next-generation sequencing (NGS) and genomics.
Knowledge of product/assay research, design, or development.
Working knowledge of statistical and mathematical methods in biology/genetics
Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation.
Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in medical device/IVD, biotech, life science or pharmaceutical industry.
Previous experience as a project lead for a team of scientists.
1+ years of direct people leadership and management experience.
Previous industry experience in product development or technical support.
Background containing a substantial amount of bioinformatics work including troubleshooting.
Previous experience working in a molecular diagnostics/clinical laboratory setting.
